svg.title: Executed lab path for the MCP gateway
svg.desc: SYN-AGENT-GO inventory.query is permitted in twelve steps and the mock returns state present. The same demo then records test.ping, the admin denial, approval, a 300-second grant, expiry, audience mismatch, policy review, revocation, the birch tenant stop, and two outages. Fresh-lab tests cover registry outage, expiry, a bad signature, credential replay, a missing bearer, and one injected excessive permission. Price none.
svg.text: THE PERMIT THAT REACHED THE MOCK
Caller bearer stays at the gateway. Downstream credential TTL is 60 seconds.
inventory mock 3 · admin mock 1 · inventory.admin calls 0 · unauthorized grants 0 · protected calls during outages 0
Same lab and the same clock. Order is the order the demo ran after the permit above.
SYN-AGENT-TESTAUTO · scope SYN-TEST · inventory mock called
No seed allow. Admin mock stays at 0. No grant is created.
Sensitive. No grant yet. Mock stays uncalled.
SYN-USER-JULES. The request stays pending for KIRAN.
Different person. Apply runs. Admin mock becomes 1.
Same token and tool. Apply is not called again.
LANGGRAPH stops while review is required.
Signature still parses. The next query stops.
Agent tenant is birch. Server tenant is cedar.
LANGGRAPH query. No cached allow. Mock holds.
Stops before parse. Principal is unknown.
Checked on the first permit. Mock sees a new JWT.
Principal, server, tool, resource, and revision.
Protected mock calls 0. Admin-tool grants stay 0.
ALSO ASSERTED ON A FRESH LAB
These six are tested. They are not steps inside the demo above.
Delegated JWT offered as the caller.
Seed has zero. A test adds one standing allow.
The demo request reason contained a token-shaped string. Stored text uses [redacted]. The report contains no raw JWT.
Each call opens an in-memory span named mcp.call. Project 1 commit b1294e2 was not contacted. LangGraph was not started.
In-process decisions on the lab clock. No network latency is shown. Price none.
